title: What the assistant was given — styled like the app
intro: You said the content is fine but the look still didn't match the app's other dialogs. Changes 1 to 12 (the words) stand. Here the look is rebuilt from the same pieces the Preferences, Permissions and Context dialogs use, nothing hand-drawn. Numbered from 13 so nothing already approved gets renumbered: (13) the header is the app's dialog header — title, one short line under it, the × at the right, a hairline; (14) the model line with the pill is gone, and the status is either the app's standard warning box or the green-dot-and-sentence line the app uses for “signed in”; (15) the body is eyebrow sections, the small uppercase labels every settings dialog uses, instead of cards with their own headings; (16) every row is the app's settings row — the same rounded card, spacing and chevron as the Preferences dialog; (17) model, context window and what was given are three plain rows under THIS CHAT, with the value on the right, the way every settings fact is shown; (18) the footer is gone, and Assistant settings is a navigating row with a chevron, like a Settings drawer row; (19) code blocks sit on the app's deepest surface with a hairline, at the app's caption size; (20) the “What it got | What was cut” switch is the app's real tab control, and the Open button beside a file is the app's small row button. Both panes on the first slide are running — click the tabs, the rows and Open.
